9.summary: Passport-style map and sponsorship materials for PCWP’s recurring Taste & Tour event.
9.content:
Taste & Tour was a recurring Parents Club of West Point event that connected participants with local businesses and destinations along the Hudson River. The featured Passport to the Hudson River was developed as the event’s compact guide and promotional piece.

Designed and planned the complete passport-style Z-fold layout, including the illustrated map, participating-business listings, advertising and sponsorship placements. Coordinated the design with PCWP, the event planner and local businesses, created the artwork in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign, and handled printing and machine folding so the finished piece folded into a passport format.
